item.name: Get aggregated carrier risk signals

request.name: Get aggregated carrier risk signals

description.content: Aggregated carrier risk assessment in a single call. Returns an AI-generated risk score (0-10) and level, plus six signal categories — authority-for-sale listings, equipment-for-sale marketplace matches, financial-distress indicators, fraud/chameleon patterns, historical authority/insurance/change-event patterns, and recent news sentiment. Each category carries a derived level of "high", "medium", "clear", or "unknown". The risk summary is cached; pass force_refresh=true to force regeneration.

query.description: Set to true to bypass the cached risk summary and regenerate it from current signals (slower).
Set to false to skip the equipment-marketplace VIN lookup for a faster response.

response.name: Scored risk header plus six derived signal categories
